principle.name: Minimal Change Principle
principle.description: Each experiment should make the smallest possible change that tests a specific hypothesis
principle.rationale: Isolating variables allows clear attribution of results to specific changes

example.good: Change only the initial learning rate value
example.bad: Change learning rate, batch size, and model width simultaneously

principle.name: Single Metric Optimization
principle.description: Focus on val_bpb as the primary optimization target
principle.rationale: Consistent metric enables fair comparison across experiments

example.bad: Compare val_bpb and training speed together

principle.name: Systematic Exploration
principle.description: Explore research space methodically, not randomly
principle.rationale: Systematic approach maximizes discoveries per experiment budget

example.good: Start with learning rate, then batch size, then architecture
example.bad: Jump between unrelated changes without pattern

principle.name: Document Every Change
principle.description: Every commit message must clearly describe the experimental change
principle.rationale: Enables追溯 of what worked and what didn't

principle.name: Hardware-Aware Design
principle.description: Design experiments within GPU memory constraints
principle.rationale: Prevents OOM crashes that waste experiment time

example.good: Increase depth from 8 to 10, keep width same
example.bad: Double both depth and width (likely OOM)

convention.rule: Use descriptive, specific commit messages that explain the experimental change

examples.good: increase LR to 0.04, reduce warmup ratio

convention.rule: Always log results to results.tsv immediately after each run
convention.template: commit val_bpb memory_gb status description a1b2c3d 0.993200 44.2 keep increase LR to 0.04

pitfall.description: Changing multiple variables in a single experiment
pitfall.why_problematic: Makes it impossible to attribute results to specific changes
pitfall.correct_approach: Change one variable at a time; if multiple changes are needed, test each separately first

pitfall.why_problematic: A hung training run wastes the entire 5-minute budget
pitfall.correct_approach: Always use timeout (10 minutes max) and check for crashes

pitfall.description: Forgetting to reset on failed experiments
pitfall.why_problematic: Corrupts git history and makes results.tsv inconsistent
pitfall.correct_approach: Always git reset --hard HEAD~1 after discard or crash

pitfall.why_problematic: Causes OOM crashes that provide no useful data
pitfall.correct_approach: Check peak_vram_mb before proposing memory-intensive changes
